title: "Connections get you a job..." (3 Tips for How to Network)
description:
Everyone says to network but they never say how. With how much digital communication happens these days think about networking mostly as just having valuable conversations with others in your industry. Give valuable insights, save a list of those you communicate with and always try to GIVE more than GET. #networking #networkingtips #linkedin #linkedintips #jobseeker #jobsearch

transcript: Here's three things to keep in mind with networking, because everybody says to, but they never say how. First is networking is really just conversations. So, wherever that happens for your industry, go there, add your valuable two cents, and get your name in front of people. Second is to keep a list of connections. So, whoever you talk to, and especially those who talk back, save that information. The Teal Contact Tracker is a great way to do that. You can quickly fill out the type of connection. A lot of their LinkedIn profile also fills out as well. And then third is to give value as much as you're trying to get. You want to comment on posts, but you also want to share your own posts. Talk about your work experiences, the various skill sets that you have, and that way you can let others also learn from you.
